## What Is This?
A **Next.js 16 App Router** single-page application that provides a premium dark-themed dashboard for the Manga Translator pipeline. It communicates with the FastAPI backend (port 8000) via a Next.js rewrite proxy — all `/api/*` requests are transparently forwarded to `localhost:8000/api/*`.
## How the Code Is Implemented
``` frontend/src/ ├── app/ │ ├── layout.tsx ← Root layout (HTML shell, font imports) │ ├── globals.css ← Full design system: tokens, components, animations (~540 lines) │ ├── page.tsx ← Dashboard page: stats, progress, pages table, ImageViewer launcher │ ├── pipeline/ │ │ └── page.tsx ← Pipeline Runner: stage visualization, run controls, SSE log console │ ├── pages/ │ │ └── page.tsx ← Pages list: filterable table, search, ImageViewer launcher │ └── settings/ │ └── page.tsx ← Settings: project dir, input subdir, model version ├── components/ │ ├── Header.tsx ← Fixed top header with page title and project path badge │ ├── Sidebar.tsx ← Fixed left sidebar with nav links and backend status │ ├── ImageViewer.tsx ← Full-screen lightbox overlay (pan, zoom, swipe, bounding boxes) │ └── ui/ ← shadcn/UI components (auto-generated) ├── lib/ │ ├── api.ts ← All fetch functions + SSE streaming helper + image URL builders │ ├── types.ts ← TypeScript interfaces matching backend Pydantic models │ └── utils.ts ← cn() helper for Tailwind class merging └── store/ └── projectStore.ts ← Zustand store: projectDir, inputSubdir, modelVersion (persisted to localStorage) ```
## Core Functionalities
### 1. Dashboard (`app/page.tsx`) - Fetches project info from `/api/project/info` on mount - Displays 4 stat cards (total pages, phase A/B done, needs review) - Progress bars for Phase A and Phase B - Manifest status panel, directory info cards - Clickable pages table → opens ImageViewer
### 2. Pipeline Runner (`app/pipeline/page.tsx`) - Visual 5-stage pipeline with animated stage nodes (done/active/idle states) - Run controls: All Stages / Single / Range mode selectors - Model version selector (v1/v2), page limit, force re-run checkbox - **SSE log streaming** via `fetch()` + `ReadableStream` (not EventSource, because we need POST) - Auto-detects active stage from log lines via regex matching - Log console with color-coded output (green=success, amber=warning, red=error)
### 3. ImageViewer Lightbox (`components/ImageViewer.tsx`) - Full-screen overlay (`fixed inset-0 z-50`) - **4 view modes:** Original (JA), Translated (EN), Side-by-Side, Interactive Swipe - Pan/zoom via React state (currently — will be replaced with `react-zoom-pan-pinch`) - Swipe via `clipPath` polygon manipulation (currently — will be replaced with `react-img-comparison-slider`) - Bounding box overlays from manifest page detail API - Region hover tooltips showing raw Japanese + English translation - Keyboard navigation (←→ arrows, Esc to close) - Pan axis lock (Free / Horizontal / Vertical)
### 4. Pages List (`app/pages/page.tsx`) - Fetches all pages, supports filter (All / Done / Pending / Review) and filename search - Full data table with phase status badges - Click any row → opens ImageViewer
### 5. Settings (`app/settings/page.tsx`) - Edits Zustand store values (auto-persisted to `localStorage`) - Project directory path, input subdirectory, model version
### 6. State Management (`store/projectStore.ts`) - Zustand with `persist` middleware → `localStorage` key: `manga-translator-project` - Stores: `projectDir`, `inputSubdir`, `modelVersion` - Default project dir: `e:\u torrentz\Manga Translator`
### 7. API Proxy (`next.config.ts`) - All `/api/*` routes are rewritten to `http://localhost:8000/api/*` - This means the frontend never makes cross-origin requests — CORS is handled transparently
## What to Check Before Editing
1. **`globals.css`** — Contains the entire design system (CSS variables, card styles, badges, buttons, progress bars, sidebar, header, tables, animations). Check here first for any visual changes. 2. **`lib/types.ts`** — All TypeScript interfaces must match the backend Pydantic models. If you add a field to a backend response, add it here too. 3. **`lib/api.ts`** — All API calls are centralized here. The `BASE` constant is `/api` (proxied). The `streamExecute()` function uses fetch+ReadableStream for POST SSE. 4. **`store/projectStore.ts`** — The default `projectDir` is hardcoded. Changing the storage key name will reset all users' saved settings. 5. **`next.config.ts`** — The rewrite rule proxies to `localhost:8000`. If the backend port changes, update here. 6. **`ImageViewer.tsx`** — The heaviest component (578 lines). Any interaction changes (pan, zoom, swipe) happen here. 7. **`"use client"` directives** — Every page and component uses `"use client"` because they all use React hooks. A full-stack manga translation system with three services:
| Service | Directory | Port | Role | |---------|-----------|------|------| | **Translation Engine** | `Manga Translator/` | **8001** | ML pipeline (OCR, translation, inpainting, typesetting) | | **Backend API** | `webui/backend/` | **8000** | FastAPI gateway (manifests, images, WebSockets, queue) | | **Frontend** | `webui/frontend/` | **3000** | Next.js dashboard & editor |
``` Browser (localhost:3000) │ ▼ Frontend (Next.js) ──proxy /api/*──► Backend (FastAPI :8000) │ ▼ REST Engine API (:8001) │ ▼ main.py pipeline (CLI) ```

## Manual Start (Three Terminals)
Use this when you want separate logs or the backend's own venv.
### Terminal 1 — Translation Engine (port 8001)
```powershell cd "E:\u torrentz\MangaTranslator FUll STACK\Manga Translator" .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 python engine_api.py ```
Health check: http://localhost:8001/api/engine/health
**CLI-only (no web UI):**
```powershell # Step 1: Create project manifest python main.py plan --project-dir "C:\path\to\your\manga\project"
# Step 2: Run full pipeline python main.py execute all --project-dir "C:\path\to\your\manga\project" ```
**Pipeline stages:**
| Stage ID | Name | Description | |----------|------|-------------| | `detect-text` | Text Detection | EasyOCR bounding boxes | | `ocr` | OCR | MangaOCR Japanese transcription | | `translate` | Translation | ArgosTranslate (offline) or Google (online) | | `inpaint` | Inpainting | Remove original text (OpenCV) | | `typeset` | Typesetting | Render English text on pages |
List stages: `python main.py stages`
Useful flags: `--force`, `--limit N`, `--pages page01.png page02.png`, `--model-version v2`
---
### Terminal 2 — Backend API (port 8000)
```powershell cd "E:\u torrentz\MangaTranslator FUll STACK\webui\backend" .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 ```
Health check: http://localhost:8000/api/health API docs: http://localhost:8000/docs
**Environment variables (optional):**
| Variable | Default | Description | |----------|---------|-------------| | `ENGINE_URL` | `http://localhost:8001` | Engine REST API URL | | `PROJECTS_DIR` | *(hardcoded paths in code)* | Base directory for manga projects (Docker) |
The backend talks to the engine over REST (`/api/engine/plan`, `/api/engine/execute`, `/api/engine/fit-font`, `/api/engine/train`) and uses a task queue to serialize heavy runs.
---
### Terminal 3 — Frontend (port 3000)
```powershell cd "E:\u torrentz\MangaTranslator FUll STACK\webui\frontend" npm run dev ```
Open: http://localhost:3000
The frontend proxies `/api/*` to the backend via `next.config.ts`:
```typescript // /api/* → http://localhost:8000/api/* ```
**Production build:**
```powershell npm run build npm run start ```

## Manga Project Folder Layout
Before translating, prepare a project directory:
``` your_manga_project/ ├── input/ # Raw Japanese page images (.png, .jpg, etc.) ├── output/ # Generated after inpaint/typeset (auto-created) ├── project_manifest.json # Created by `plan` command └── project_manifest.json.bak # Auto backup on saves ```
In the Web UI **Settings** page, set **Project Directory** to this folder (default in code may differ).

## Startup Order
1. **Engine** (8001) — must be up before backend pipeline calls 2. **Backend** (8000) — must be up before frontend API calls 3. **Frontend** (3000)
`start.ps1` handles this order and skips services that are already running.
---
## Troubleshooting
| Problem | Fix | |---------|-----| | Engine won't start | Activate venv; run `pip install -r requirements.txt`; check CUDA/GPU drivers | | Backend can't reach engine | Confirm engine on 8001; set `ENGINE_URL=http://localhost:8001` | | Frontend API errors | Confirm backend on 8000; check `next.config.ts` rewrite target | | CORS errors | Backend allows `localhost:3000`; use frontend proxy (`/api/...`), not direct `:8000` calls | | GPU OOM during pipeline | Run one stage at a time: `python main.py execute --stage ocr` | | Wrong project path in UI | Settings → update Project Directory (stored in `localStorage`) |
